description: The bar chart illustrates the module-level Giga FLOPs (floating-point operations) for different components of the Audio back-end Conformer across three stages, with each stage corresponding to a different configuration of model dimensions (d) and number of parameters (n). The x-axis represents the three stages: Stage 1 (d=180, n=500), Stage 2 (d=256, n=250), and Stage 3 (d=360, n=125), while the y-axis shows the Giga FLOPs, ranging from 0 to 0.3. Four types of components are compared: attention (blue), grouped attention (g=3) (red), patch attention (k=3) (yellow), and feed-forward (green). In Stage 1, the attention component has the highest FLOPs at approximately 0.28, followed by grouped attention at around 0.16, patch attention at about 0.14, and feed-forward at roughly 0.15. In Stage 2, the attention component has FLOPs of about 0.17, grouped attention at 0.14, patch attention at 0.13, and feed-forward at 0.15. In Stage 3, the attention component has FLOPs of approximately 0.13, grouped attention at 0.12, patch attention at 0.12, and feed-forward at 0.15. The chart shows that the attention component consistently has the highest FLOPs across all stages, while the feed-forward component has the lowest FLOPs in Stages 2 and 3. The grouped attention and patch attention components have similar FLOPs values, with patch attention slightly lower in all stages.
